- 75e4ac19-3b0b-4b2a-8241-954298598ee9: Upload the file using: curl -X PUT -H "Content-Type: image/png" --data-binary @ref-red.png 'https://upload.higgsfield.test/user_TEST/upload.png?X-Amz-Signature=test Run that PUT where the bytes already are: the user's own machine for a path they supplied, or the same sandbox_exec command that creates a sandbox file. Never relay the bytes between environments as base64 or text chunks, and never upload through the higgsfield.ai web interface. After upload, call the media_confirm tool with type "image" and media_id "75e4ac19-3b0b-4b2a-8241-954298598ee9".
